offering_description.value: Manufactures cement for ready-mix producers, concrete product manufacturers, contractors and building materials dealers. Its subsidiaries batch ready-mixed concrete for delivery to job sites and sell concrete products and related building materials.

primary_products.value: Portland cement; masonry cement; ready-mixed concrete; concrete products; related building materials

customer_segment.value: B2B: Ready-mix producers, concrete product manufacturers, construction contractors and building materials dealers; B2G: Government agencies purchasing materials for public works

end_markets.value: Commercial construction; residential construction; roads and public infrastructure; concrete products manufacturing

revenue_model.value: product sales: Bulk cement, ready-mixed concrete, concrete products and building supplies

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Processes quarried materials into cement and batches concrete for producers, dealers and contractors; asset operator: Operates a limestone quarry, a cement plant and ready-mix plants that supply regional construction customers; distributor: Sources related building materials and sells them to contractors and other construction customers

geography_served.value: US regional: Kansas, Iowa and parts of Nebraska, Missouri, Arkansas and Oklahoma

specialization.value: related lines: Cement manufacturing, ready-mixed concrete, concrete products and related building supplies

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Bulk cement sales to producers and ready-mix deliveries to construction sites; distributors / dealers: Building materials dealers that buy and resell cement; own locations: Subsidiary concrete plants and building materials outlets
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; distributors / dealers; own locations

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: EPA and state air emissions rules for cement manufacturing and federal mine safety rules for quarrying
